content_data.meeting_title: Robotics Ethics and Governance Framework Development - Steering Committee Update
agenda_items: Review of current ethical guidelines for autonomous systems in European context
Open issues and challenges in cross-border regulatory harmonization
key_decisions: Prioritize development of a modular ethics assessment toolkit for robotics projects.
Formulate joint working group with legal experts for cross-border data governance issues.
action_items: Dr. Elena Petrova: Coordinate with legal department to initiate the joint working group on data governance within two weeks.
Dr. Anya Sharma: Circulate draft of ethical guidelines version 1.2 to committee members by end of next week.
